:::{#exm-total-variance}
#### Decomposing the variance of a binary outcome

Continuing @exm-cond-variance,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\P(X = 0) &= \P(X = 1) \\
&= 0.5,
\end{aligned}
$$

$\E{Y \mid X = 0} = 0.6$, and $\E{Y \mid X = 1} = 0.8$,
so $\E{\E{Y \mid X}} = 0.7$, and by @thm-total-variance:

$$
\ba
\E{\Var{Y \mid X}}
&= 0.5 \cd 0.24 + 0.5 \cd 0.16
&& \text{(average the conditional variances)} \\
&= 0.20 \\
\Var{\E{Y \mid X}}
&= 0.5 \cd (0.6 - 0.7)^2 + 0.5 \cd (0.8 - 0.7)^2
&& \text{(variance of the conditional means)} \\
&= 0.01 \\
\Var{Y}
&= 0.20 + 0.01
&& \text{(law of total variance)} \\
&= 0.21
\ea
$$

As a check, $Y$ is Bernoulli with

$$
\begin{aligned}
\P(Y = 1) &= 0.3 + 0.4 \\
&= 0.7,
\end{aligned}
$$

so by @exm-variance-bernoulli,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Var{Y} &= 0.7 \cd 0.3 \\
&= 0.21.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
